Removing differential bearings

Check for notching and excessive wear on the ring gear teeth. The bearings must be replaced whenever they show signs of scoring, excessive play and wear.
1. Undo the fixing bolts (1a) and remove the ring gear (1b).
1. Remove the upper differential gear.

1. Remove the planet carrier pin.

The planet carrier pin should not show signs of binding, wear or excessive wear on the half casings.

1. Remove the planet wheels (1a) and the lower differential gear (1b).

The planet gears should not be chipped or worn on the working surfaces.
1. Separate the ring gear (1a) from the differential half-casing at the press (1b).
